typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DSTloadintotempextendedproperties_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DW_Column as string,
		DatabaseType as string,
		SourceFrom as string,
		DBNAME as string,
		Stg_Column as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> SRCextendedpropertiesfromstg
SRCextendedpropertiesfromstg sink(input(
		TargetMapping as string,
		DatabaseType as string,
		SourceFrom as string,
		DBName as string,
		SourceMapping as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TargetMapping = DW_Column,
		DatabaseType,
		SourceFrom,
		DBName = DBNAME,
		SourceMapping = Stg_Column),
	partitionFileNames:[($DSTloadintotempextendedproperties_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> DSTloadintotempextendedproperties
